biography: Former Permanent Secretary in the Mauritian Government and now freelance trainer in Public Policy for  serving Public Officers ,  I am very keen to get updated on  Artificial Intelligence (AI) , its benefits, risks challenges and safeguards in Government adoption of AI and its impact on public policy especially for developing countries like Mauritius . I am presently following. a course with the Said  Oxford Business School / UNESCO  on AI and Digital Transformation in Government . I have also registered  with ITU Academy  to follow a course on " Responsible  Digital Transformation: Impact Assessment for AI and Data Governance" I'm very keen to uncover how AI can impact on public policies which are already facing many challenges . If I can help through capacity building and sharing of my experience  In Public sector for more than 40 years coupled with AI looming ahead  would be great
